tool: viron-strata --headless --frames (live, against a throwaway local Viron driven by tools/driver.py)
commands: cmake -S src/viron-strata -B work-b/vs-build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build work-b/vs-build -j8  # cmake 4
git clone https://github.com/Preponderous-Software/viron work-b/viron && git -C work-b/viron checkout bd4a1f82a460a2888042880a68347c91cb84c2c5  # CI's VIRON_COMMIT
runuser -u postgres -- initdb -D work-b/pg/data -U postgres --auth=trust; pg_ctl start -o '-p 55432 -c listen_addresses=127.0.0.1'  # throwaway PostgreSQL 12 in scratch
build/viron-strata --viron-url http://127.0.0.1:19999 --environment 3 --headless --duration 2 --verify  # -> verify: ok, 16 placements match
frames/0000..0134.png = vs-frames/frame-00030..00164.png (skips the first 2 s; copy only)
frames scaled to 640x400 (Lanczos); clip.webm (VP9) and clip.mp4 (H.264) at 15 fps; poster.jpg is one frame of the clip
notes: Recorded live, not from the committed GIF: a throwaway Viron (bd4a1f8, CI's pin) on a scratch PostgreSQL 12 cluster, per docs/LOCAL_VIRON.md, with ports moved (Viron 19999 via --server.port, PostgreSQL 55432) to avoid defaults. No Docker. The client has no offline/fixture mode (--verify needs a live Viron too). Camera tweaked from the default (--yaw 12 --pitch 50 --zoom 0.97) for a more 3D 16:10 framing. The random walk does not loop seamlessly (cut at the end). The HUD's third line ('polled every 250 ms; not tick-exact') is the tool's small font and is not legible at 800 px; the first two HUD lines are.
